messages:
Maya: Quick async — Dry-run for v2 rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Posting checklist + asks. TL;DR: warmup slices 5% -> 20% over 40m. Need ops watch, SLO sanity check, and two CR approvals for canary config. Anyone able to take CRs? /cc @Alex @Jamal :eyes:

Alex: I can take CRs. Will review config in ~30m. Any special traffic shaping flags?

Jamal: Ops: I'll be online for the window. Can you upload the exact feature-flag names? I'll wire alerting.

Maya: Flags: rollout.v2.enable, rollout.v2.kv_cache=true. Also config snippet:
```
slice_percent: 5 -> 20
ramp_minutes: 40
fallback_model: v1
```

Lina: FYI perf: last dry run saw ~10% p99 latency bump past seq>512. Recommend we cap max_seq=512 for the canary.

Product-ops: Noted — if we cap seq, some user flows may degrade. Suggest a quick eval run against the standard prompt set before ramp.

Alex: CR1: LGTM but change cache TTL to 30s (was 5s). Diff to apply: `- cache_ttl: 5s
+ cache_ttl: 30s`

Jamal: Alerts wired. Pager oncall notified: @oncall-night. Added alert rule: error_rate > 5% OR p99 latency delta > +250ms => page. Dashboards: rollout-v2-dryrun.

DevEx-bot: Scheduled dry-run job created: job/rollout-v2-dryrun-2378901234 (eta 23:00 UTC).

Maya: Blockers: need one more CR and a short smoke-test checklist. Who can own smoke? @Lina?

Lina: I can run smoke at T+5m and share logs. Quick smoke steps: 1) small prompt generation 2) check p50/p95 latency and errors 3) confirm kv cache warming (prefix hits). Will post results in this thread.

Alex: Second CR done and pushed. Merging in 10m. Also pinging infra to spin up an extra GPU warm pool for the window.

Infra-bot: Warm pool expansion requested. Request ID rp-9921. Estimated ETA: ~12m.

Maya: Perfect. I will post final readiness at 22:40 UTC and a short go/no-go checklist (smoke green, alerts set, CRs merged, warm pool ready). Thanks everyone :pray:
